newsitem.title: UK: Argentina bond seen on hold until market improves.
newsitem.headline: Argentina bond seen on hold until market improves.

text.p: Argentina's $750 million seven-year global bond was on hold until market conditions improved, bankers close to the deal said on Friday.
Inventory was high across-the-board and the markets needed time to pause for breath, bankers said.

"Nothing has been decided. If the market improves we'll look at it seriously," a syndicate official at CSFB said. "Generally everything has gone low key and emerging market volumes have dropped off," he added.
A syndicate official at SBC Warburg confirmed the launch would depend on the tone of the markets next week.
CSFB and SBC Warburg -- joint lead managers of the transaction -- said on Wednesday the bond would be delayed due to market volatility.
Dealers away from the lead managers said on Friday the bond was expected to be launched at 185 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes.
